convert_asciidoc_to_docling_document: convert an AsciiDoc file into a structured DoclingDocument with headings, lists, tables, and images
parse_asciidoc_section_headers: parse AsciiDoc section headers with multiple levels and build a hierarchical parent-child structure
parse_asciidoc_list_items: parse AsciiDoc list items with nested indentation levels and bullet or numbered markers
parse_asciidoc_tables: parse AsciiDoc table blocks delimited by |=== markers into a grid-based TableData structure
parse_asciidoc_images_with_captions: parse AsciiDoc image macros with optional dimensions, paths, and multiline captions
